title.narrative: Products and services from research and statistics in the region have strengthened the ILO's position as a global centre of excellence

description.narrative: Research and statistics contribute to the Office’s social justice endeavours. The regional “flagship” Asia-Pacific Employment and Social Outlook 2024 provides up-to-date trends crucial to showcase the palsy of social justice in the region. ILO supports countries in producing, reporting and using relevant statistics, particularly on topics like new work relationships, new statistics on the informal economy and SDG indicators relating to decent work, following the latest statistical standards adopted by the 20th and 21st ICLS, and contributing to the achievement of SDG targets on data availability and measurements of progress on sustainable development. ILO also undertakes research that responds to the constituents’ needs to enable policy development through a human-centred approach in support of social justice. Emphasis is put on enhanced training of constituents on evidence-based policy making to strengthen institutional capacities to improve the design, evaluation, and implementation of the world of work in public policies.
